셋업이 통제 불가 요인이라 실제 산출만 줄인다고 생각함
계획된 정비가 통제 불가 요인이라고 생각함
problems.s: L06 p.11: 셋업, 정비, 휴식은 유효 용량을 정할 때 빼는 통제 가능 요인입니다. 자재 부족은 통제할 수 없는 요인이라 실제 산출을 낮춥니다.

dx.principle: 가동률 = 실제 ÷ 설계, 효율 = 실제 ÷ 유효

problems.q: A line has design capacity 50 trucks/day, effective capacity 40 trucks/day and actual output 36 trucks/day. Compute utilization (%).
problems.s: L06 p.14–15: Utilization = actual ÷ design = 36 ÷ 50 = 72%.

problems.q: Using the same line (design 50, effective 40, actual 36 trucks/day), compute efficiency (%).
problems.s: L06 p.14: Efficiency = actual ÷ effective = 36 ÷ 40 = 90%. 가동률은 설계 용량, 효율은 유효 용량으로 나눕니다.

problems.q: Design capacity is 80 units/day, effective capacity 70 units/day and actual output 56 units/day. Compute the capacity cushion (%).
problems.s:
L06 p.20: Capacity cushion = 100% − utilization. Utilization = 56 ÷ 80 = 70% → cushion = 30%.

함정: 효율(56 ÷ 70 = 80%)을 빼면 20%가 나옵니다.

problems.q: The more uncertain demand is, the smaller the capacity cushion an organization should keep.
problems.fix: More demand uncertainty calls for a larger capacity cushion.
problems.s: L06 p.20: More demand uncertainty, need more capacity cushion. 수강신청 시스템처럼 몰리는 수요에 대비합니다.

problems.q: One machine works one 8-hour shift, 250 days a year. Yearly demand and standard time per unit: Product A 600 units, 3.0 h; Product B 400 units, 4.0 h; Product C 1,000 units, 1.5 h. How many machines are required?
Same demand as before (A 600 units at 3.0 h, B 400 at 4.0 h, C 1,000 at 1.5 h, 250 days a year), but each machine now works two 8-hour shifts a day. How many machines are required?
Measuring capacity in dollars is problematic because dollar values change over time, so the measure would keep needing updates.
problems.s: L06 p.11: Measure capacity in units that do not require updating. 달러는 물가에 따라 바뀝니다.

problems.q: A company makes 100 different products on the same equipment. Which capacity measure is most practical?
opts: Number of finished units in inventory
Units of each product per day
why: 재고 수량이 용량을 나타낸다고 생각함
제품이 많아도 제품별 수량으로 표시해야 한다고 생각함
용량을 달러 금액으로 재도 된다고 생각함
problems.s: L06 p.16: 제품이 너무 많으면 제품별 표시는 실용적이지 않으므로 투입물 기준(300 machine hours per day)으로 표시합니다.

problems.q: A following strategy builds capacity in anticipation of future demand increases.
problems.fix: A leading strategy builds in anticipation; a following strategy builds when demand exceeds current capacity.
problems.s: L06 p.40: 미리 늘리는 것은 leading strategy. Following은 수요가 현재 용량을 넘은 뒤에 늘립니다.

problems.q: Which capacity strategy is similar to the following strategy, but adds capacity in relatively small increments to keep pace with increasing demand?
problems.s: L06 p.40: Tracking strategy.

problems.q: Because services cannot be stored for consumption later, service capacity planning is harder than product capacity planning.
problems.s: L06 p.25: 서비스 용량 계획의 어려움 — 고객 가까이 있어야 함, 저장할 수 없음, 수요 변동성.

problems.q: Using extra or temporary workers is a demand management strategy in service capacity planning.
problems.fix: Extra or temporary workers and outsourcing adjust supply; demand management uses pricing, promotions and discounts.
problems.s: L06 p.26: 임시 인력·외주는 공급(용량) 쪽 전략입니다. Demand management는 가격, 홍보, 할인으로 수요를 바쁜 때에서 한가한 때로 옮기는 것입니다.

problems.q: What is the operation in a sequence of operations whose capacity is lower than that of the other operations?
problems.s: L06 p.34: Bottleneck operation.

problems.q: Three operations run in sequence with capacities of 50, 30 and 45 units per hour. What is the capacity of the whole system (units per hour)?
problems.s: L06 p.34: 시스템 용량은 가장 낮은 단계, 즉 병목(30)이 정합니다. 단계 용량을 더하거나 평균하지 않습니다.

dx.principle: 최적 운영 수준을 기준으로 규모의 경제·불경제가 갈린다

problems.q: Beyond the optimal operating level, diseconomies of scale arise, for example because distribution costs rise from traffic congestion and shipping from one centralized facility.
problems.s: L06 p.38: 규모의 불경제 이유 — 교통 혼잡과 중앙 집중 시설에서의 배송으로 유통비 증가, 복잡성, 경직성, 느린 의사결정.

problems.q: Increasing the output rate always lowers the average cost per unit, because fixed costs are spread over more units.
problems.fix: Only below the optimal operating level; beyond it, diseconomies of scale raise the average cost per unit.
problems.s:
L06 p.38: 고정비 분산은 최적 운영 수준 아래에서만 단위비용을 낮춥니다. 최적 수준을 넘으면 규모의 불경제로 단위비용이 오릅니다.

함정: 'always'.

problems.q: In which stage of the product life cycle should a firm be cautious about making large or inflexible capacity commitments, because both the market size and its eventual share are hard to determine?
why: 성장기에 시장 규모를 가장 알기 어렵다고 생각함
성숙기에 대규모 용량을 피해야 한다고 생각함
쇠퇴기에 신중히 증설을 판단해야 한다고 생각함
problems.s: L06 p.33: 도입기 — 규모와 점유율을 알기 어려워 크고 경직된 용량을 조심. 성장기는 과잉 주의, 성숙기는 증설 검토, 쇠퇴기는 과잉 용량 처분이나 이전.

problems.q: In the in-house or outsource decision process, if the item cannot be purchased, the decision is to outsource.
problems.fix: If the item cannot be purchased, it must be made in-house; a No at the later gates leads to outsourcing.
problems.s: L06 p.29: 첫 관문 'Can the item be purchased?'에서 No면 살 수 없으니 자체 생산(in-house)입니다. 그 뒤의 관문(만들 수 있나, 더 싼가, 자본이 있나)에서 No면 외주입니다.

problems.q: Fixed cost is $6,000 per month, variable cost is $2 per unit and revenue is $7 per unit. Compute the break-even quantity (units per month).
Same costs (FC $6,000 per month, v $2, R $7). How many units per month must be sold to earn a profit of $4,000?
When capacity alternatives involve step costs, there can be more than one break-even quantity, so each output range must be checked separately.
problems.s: L06 p.46–47: 기계를 추가하면 고정비가 계단식으로 올라 구간마다 손익분기점이 생길 수 있고, 계산한 BEP가 그 구간 밖이면 그 구간의 BEP는 없습니다.

problems.q: Annual demand is between 580 and 660 units. One machine covers 0–300 units (FC $9,600), two machines cover 301–600 (FC $15,000), three machines cover 601–900 (FC $20,000). Variable cost is $10/unit and revenue $40/unit. Which statement is correct?
opts: Buy two machines, because their BEP is in range and below this demand
Buy one machine, because it has the lowest fixed cost of all
Any choice works, because R and v give every option the same BEP
Buy three machines, because demand can exceed the 600-unit range
problems.a: Buy two machines, because their BEP is in range and below this demand
why: 고정비가 가장 낮은 대안이 항상 최선이라고 생각함
계단식 고정비에서도 손익분기점이 하나라고 생각함
수요 상한만 보고 BEP를 확인하지 않아도 된다고 생각함
problems.s: L06 p.47: BEP = FC ÷ (R − v) = FC ÷ 30. 1대: 320 (범위 0–300 밖 → BEP 없음). 2대: 500 (범위 안). 3대: 666.7 → 660을 넘어 수요 범위에서는 손실. 그래서 2대를 삽니다.

problems.q: Cost-volume analysis assumes that everything produced can be sold and that the revenue per unit exceeds the variable cost per unit.
problems.s: L06 p.48: 가정 — 단일 제품, 생산량 전부 판매, 단위 변동비·단가 일정, 단가 > 변동비, 고정비 일정 또는 계단식.

problems.q: Define design capacity, effective capacity and actual output. Explain which kinds of factors separate each level from the next, and give the formulas for utilization and efficiency.
problems.a: Design capacity is the maximum output rate a facility is designed for. Effective capacity is design capacity minus allowances such as setups, maintenance and break times — factors that can be controlled. Actual output is the rate actually achieved; it falls below effective capacity because of factors out of control such as machine breakdowns, absences, material shortages and quality problems. Utilization = actual output ÷ design capacity; efficiency = actual output ÷ effective capacity.
pts: Effective = design − controllable allowances (setup, maintenance, breaks)
Actual < effective because of uncontrollable factors (breakdown, absence, shortage)
problems.s: L06 p.11, 14. 통제 가능 여부로 두 단계를 나누는 것이 핵심입니다.

problems.q: Explain economies of scale and diseconomies of scale relative to the optimal operating level, giving two reasons for each.
problems.a: Below the optimal operating level, increasing output lowers average cost per unit (economies of scale): fixed costs are spread over more units, construction costs rise at a decreasing rate as size grows, and processing costs fall with standardization. Above it, increasing output raises average cost per unit (diseconomies of scale): distribution costs rise from congestion and shipping from one central facility, complexity increases costs, and a big organization is inflexible and slow to decide.
pts: Economies: below optimal level, unit cost falls
Reasons: fixed cost spread / construction cost / standardization (2개)
Diseconomies: above optimal level, unit cost rises

problems.q: Name the four gates of the in-house or outsource decision process in order, and state what a No at each gate decides.
problems.a: 1) Can the item be purchased? No → make it in-house. 2) Can we make the item? No → outsource. 3) Is it cheaper for us to make than to buy? No → outsource. 4) Is the capital available to make it? No → outsource. Only Yes at all four ends in making the item in-house.
problems.s: L06 p.29–30 (Tompkins et al.).

problems.q: Capital intensity is the mix of equipment and labor that will be used by the organization.
problems.s: L07 p.8: process selection strategy의 두 측면 — capital intensity(장비·노동 배합)와 process flexibility.

problems.q: High capital intensity always means low process flexibility.
problems.fix: High capital intensity can coexist with flexibility, as in a programmable automated handling cell.
problems.s:
L07 p.9: 전용 빵 라인은 장비 투자가 크고 유연성이 낮지만, 자동 핸들링 셀은 장비 투자가 커도 프로그램된 로봇이 여러 제품을 옮깁니다. High capital intensity can coexist with flexibility.

함정: 'always'.

problems.q: A different repair job arrives each day, and routes and task times vary from job to job. Which process type fits?
why: 다양성이 큰 작업에 연속 공정이 맞는다고 생각함
작업마다 경로가 달라도 묶음 생산이 맞는다고 생각함
다양한 일회성 작업에 반복 라인이 맞는다고 생각함
problems.s: L07 p.11: 날마다 다른 수리 작업 → job shop(경로·작업 시간이 다름).

problems.q: Crude oil is processed in a refinery. Which process type is this?
problems.s: L07 p.11, 13: refinery → continuous process.

problems.q: A bakery makes a group of similar loaves, then changes the recipe and makes the next group. Which process type is this?
problems.s: L07 p.11, 13: 비슷한 단위를 묶어 만들고 다음 묶음으로 바꿈 → batch.

problems.q: As the required variety increases and the production volume decreases, the appropriate process moves from continuous toward job shop.
problems.s: L07 p.15: 다양성 높고 생산량 적음 = job shop, 다양성 낮고 생산량 많음 = continuous.

problems.q: The main operating challenge of a repetitive process is setup time and batch-size decisions.
problems.fix: Setup time and batch size belong to batch processes; repetitive lines must balance stations and handle disruptions.
problems.s: L07 p.14: 셋업 시간·배치 크기는 batch의 과제입니다. Repetitive(조립 라인)의 과제는 작업장 균형과 중단 대응입니다.

problems.q: A neighborhood bakery that bakes 30 kinds of bread by hand wins a large, stable daily order for one standard loaf. Where does this work move on the variety–volume matrix?
opts: Toward lower volume, closer to batch
Toward higher variety, closer to a job shop
Toward lower variety and higher volume, closer to repetitive or continuous
Nowhere, because the bakery still sells bread
problems.a: Toward lower variety and higher volume, closer to repetitive or continuous
why: 큰 단일 주문이 생산량을 줄인다고 생각함
주문이 커지면 다양성이 오른다고 생각함
같은 업종이면 공정 유형이 바뀌지 않는다고 생각함
problems.s: L07 p.6, 15: 한 가지 표준 빵을 많이 → 다양성은 낮아지고 생산량은 많아져 반복·연속 쪽으로 이동합니다. 같은 업종도 여러 공정 유형을 쓸 수 있습니다(p.11).

dx.principle: 자동화는 다음 제품으로 바꾸는 방식으로 구분

problems.q: Programmable automation can run a new product after a program change and setup, as when a CNC machine runs a new program after tooling and setup.
problems.s: L07 p.18: programmable automation = 프로그램과 셋업 변경.

problems.q: Fixed automation allows quick switching among a prepared mix of products with little changeover delay.
problems.fix: Quick switching describes flexible automation; fixed automation may need equipment modification for a major change.
problems.s:
L07 p.18: 빠른 전환은 flexible automation. Fixed automation은 정해진 작업 순서라 큰 변경에 장비 개조가 필요합니다.

함정: 로봇이 있느냐가 아니라 전환 방식으로 구분합니다.

problems.q: Which system connects design, process planning, production control and business information across the whole manufacturing system — an information integration broader than shop-floor resources? (abbreviation)
problems.s: L07 p.21: CIM(computer-integrated manufacturing)은 정보 통합, FMS는 기계·팔레트·일정의 현장 통합입니다.

problems.q: Installing one CNC machine makes a factory a flexible manufacturing system (FMS).
problems.fix: One CNC machine is programmable automation; an FMS coordinates several machines, pallet transfer and scheduling.
problems.s: L07 p.21: FMS는 자동 팔레트 이송으로 여러 가공 자원을 잇고 일정으로 부품 묶음을 조정합니다. CNC 한 대는 프로그램 자동화일 뿐입니다.

problems.q: Which layout keeps the product stationary while workers, materials and equipment come to it, as in shipbuilding?
problems.s: L07 p.31: fixed-position layout. 건물, 발전소, 댐도 예입니다.

problems.q: In an automatic car wash, every customer follows the same sequence of steps. Which layout is this?
why: 고객이 머무르면 고정 위치 배치라고 생각함
공통 순서 흐름을 셀 배치로 생각함
서비스 시설은 모두 공정별 배치라고 생각함
problems.s: L07 p.38: 자동 세차·카페테리아 = product layout(공통 순서). 병원·은행은 process, 집수리는 fixed-position.

problems.q: In a process layout, each job visits only the departments it needs, so routing, scheduling and material movement become important.
problems.s: L07 p.29–30: 기계 공장처럼 작업마다 경로가 달라 경로 선택, 우선순위, 운반·대기·재공 관리가 중요합니다.

problems.q: In a process layout, an available alternative machine always reduces a job's completion time.
problems.fix: An alternative machine must be technically feasible, and extra travel or waiting can keep the completion time from falling.
problems.s: L07 p.30: 대체 기계는 기술적으로 가능한지 확인해야 하고, 운반 거리와 대기가 늘면 완료 시간이 줄지 않을 수 있습니다.

problems.q: Cellular manufacturing groups machines into a cell to produce a corresponding part family.
problems.s: L07 p.35: A cell groups machines to produce a corresponding part family — 큰 잡숍 안의 작은 흐름 라인.

problems.q: Cellular manufacturing increases work in process and lead time.
problems.fix: Cellular manufacturing reduces work in process, space and lead time.
problems.s: L07 p.35: 셀 생산의 효과 — 다양한 제품을 효율적으로, 운반·지연 최소, 생산성·품질 향상, 재공품·공간·리드타임 감소.

problems.q: Grouping parts into families by similar design characteristics (size, shape, function), processing characteristics, or both is called what? (two words)
problems.s: L07 p.34: group technology(GT).

problems.q: A line has 8 available hours per day and the target output is 240 units per day. What cycle time is needed (minutes per unit)?
problems.s: L07 p.41: Cycle time = operating time per day ÷ output rate = 480 ÷ 240 = 2 min/unit.

problems.q: A line has 8 available hours per day and its current cycle time is 3 minutes per unit. What is its output rate (units per day)?
problems.s: L07 p.41: Output rate = operating time per day ÷ cycle time = 480 ÷ 3 = 160 units/day.

problems.q: The total time of all tasks on a line is 7.4 minutes and the cycle time is 2 minutes. What is the theoretical minimum number of workstations?
problems.s: L07 p.43: Nmin = ceiling(7.4 ÷ 2) = ceiling(3.7) = 4.

problems.q: Three indivisible tasks A (3 min) → B (5 min) → C (2 min) must be done in this order with a 5-minute cycle time. Because Nmin = ceiling(10 ÷ 5) = 2, the line can be balanced with two stations.
problems.fix: Three stations are needed; A and C cannot share a station because B must occur between them.
problems.s:
L07 p.44: A와 C는 사이에 B가 있어 한 작업장에 함께 둘 수 없습니다. A / B / C로 3개가 필요합니다. Nmin은 하한일 뿐 실현 가능한 배정이 아닙니다.

함정: 총시간만 보고 선행 관계를 빼먹음.

problems.q: Three stations in a line can process 20, 10 and 30 units per hour. The line output is 60 units per hour.
problems.fix: The line output is limited by the slowest station: 10 units per hour.
problems.s: L07 p.40: 라인 산출은 가장 느린 작업장이 정합니다 → 10 units/hour. 작업장 처리 속도를 더하지 않습니다.

dx.principle: 효율 = busy ÷ (N × CT), 균형 지연 = idle ÷ (N × CT)

problems.q: A line with a cycle time of 1 minute has three stations whose busy times per cycle are 0.8, 1.0 and 0.7 minutes. Compute the line efficiency (%).
Same line (cycle time 1 minute, station busy times 0.8, 1.0 and 0.7 minutes). Compute the balance delay (%).
Under the greatest positional weight rule for assigning tasks to workstations, what value ranks the tasks?
opts: The task's time plus the times of all its successors
The number of all following tasks
problems.a: The task's time plus the times of all its successors
why: 후속 작업 개수가 위치 가중치라고 생각함
위치 가중치가 자기 작업 시간만이라고 생각함
바로 뒤 작업 수가 위치 가중치라고 생각함
problems.s: L07 p.45: positional weight = 작업 시간 + 모든 후속 작업 시간. 후속 작업 '개수'는 most following tasks 규칙입니다(직속뿐 아니라 모든 후속).

problems.q: When assigning tasks to a station, a task is a candidate only if all its predecessors are already assigned and it fits in the remaining time; the priority rule then chooses among the candidates.
problems.s: L07 p.45: 순서는 ① eligibility(선행 작업이 모두 배정됨) ② 남은 시간에 들어감 ③ 그 후보 중 우선순위 규칙.

problems.q: Departments are placed and evaluated by load–distance. Pair 1–2: 50 loads/day over 30 m; pair 1–3: 20 loads/day over 10 m; pair 2–3: 80 loads/day over 20 m. Compute the total load–distance (load-metres per day).
Same layout (total 3,300 load-metres per day). If moving one load one metre costs $0.50, what is the daily transport cost ($)?
problems.s: L07 p.54: load × distance에 단위 운송비를 곱하면 금액 비용 → 3,300 × 0.5 = $1,650.

problems.q: In a Muther grid, an X rating means two departments should be as close as possible because of strong material flow.
problems.fix: A means strong closeness (e.g. strong material flow); X means incompatible activities that should be kept apart.
problems.s: L07 p.55: A = 꼭 가까이(강한 물류 흐름), X = 양립할 수 없는 활동이라 떨어뜨림.

problems.q: To reduce total load–distance in a process layout, department pairs with high flows should be matched with short routes.
problems.s: L07 p.53–54: Match high flows with short routes.

problems.q: Describe the steps for designing a product layout by line balancing: how the cycle time and the minimum number of stations are found, how tasks are assigned, how the result is measured, and why the minimum number may not be feasible.
problems.a: Compute the cycle time = operating time per day ÷ desired output. Compute Nmin = ceiling(total task time ÷ cycle time); this is only a lower bound. Assign tasks station by station: a task is a candidate only if all its predecessors are assigned (eligibility) and it fits in the remaining time; among candidates use a priority rule such as most following tasks or greatest positional weight. Measure with efficiency = busy ÷ (N × CT) and balance delay = idle ÷ (N × CT). Precedence can force more stations than Nmin, as when A and C cannot share a station because B lies between them.
pts: Assignment: eligibility → fits time → priority rule
선행 관계로 Nmin보다 많이 필요할 수 있음

problems.q: Compare product layouts and process layouts: what moves, what each enables, and what the manager must control in each.
problems.a: In a product layout units follow a common sequence of standardized operations, giving smooth, rapid, high-volume flow with simple routing and short material movement; the manager must balance work so one station does not limit output and respond quickly to breakdowns, since one stopped station affects the line. In a process layout jobs visit only the functional departments they need, so general-purpose resources serve varied jobs; the manager must choose routes, resolve competing priorities and limit travel, queues and work in process.
pts: Product: common sequence, high volume, standardized
Product: balance stations, one stop affects line
Process: varied routes through functional departments

problems.q: Name the four process types. For each, give one example and its main operating challenge.
problems.a: Job shop (repair work): different jobs follow different routes; challenge — routing, scheduling and skilled labor. Batch (bakery runs): groups of similar units share equipment; challenge — setup time and batch size. Repetitive (assembly line): discrete units repeat a sequence; challenge — balancing stations and handling disruptions. Continuous (oil refinery): uninterrupted material flow; challenge — high investment and costly shutdowns.

problems.q: Job design specifies the contents and methods of a job: what is done, who does it, how it is done and where.
problems.s: L08 p.6: 직무설계 = 내용과 방법. 생산성, 안전, 근로생활의 질을 위해 설계합니다.

problems.q: Job enlargement adds planning and coordination responsibility to a job.
problems.fix: Job enlargement adds related tasks at the same responsibility level; job enrichment adds planning and coordination responsibility.
problems.s: L08 p.8: Job enlargement = 같은 책임 수준의 관련 과업 추가. 계획·조정 책임을 더하는 것은 job enrichment. 'Adding more tasks and adding more authority are different changes.'

dx.principle: 과업을 늘리는 것과 권한을 늘리는 것은 다르다

problems.q: Workers exchange assembly, inspection and packing roles according to a schedule. Name this behavioral approach to job design. (two words)
problems.s: L08 p.8: job rotation — 역할을 교대합니다.

problems.q: Which behavioral change adds more authority to a job, rather than only more tasks?
why: 과업을 더하는 것이 곧 권한을 더하는 것이라고 생각함
기계화가 직무의 권한을 늘린다고 생각함
역할 교대가 권한을 늘린다고 생각함
problems.s: L08 p.8: enrichment = 계획·조정 책임 추가. enlargement는 같은 수준의 과업 추가, rotation은 역할 교대, mechanization은 장비로 반복 노력을 줄임.

problems.q: The efficiency approach to job design emphasizes specialization, while the behavioral approach broadens the job and supports the worker.
problems.s: L08 p.7–8: 효율 접근 = specialization(반복성 대 단조로움·낮은 자율). 직무를 넓히고 작업자를 지원하는 것은 행동 접근.

problems.q: A group of workers that simply meets together, without any decision authority, is a self-directed team.
problems.fix: A self-directed team makes specified work-process decisions within agreed limits; meeting alone does not make it self-directed.
problems.s: L08 p.12: self-directed team은 합의된 한도 안에서 정해진 작업 공정 결정을 직접 내립니다. 'A group meeting alone does not make a team self-directed.'

problems.q: Time-based compensation gives stable labor costs and is easy to administer, but it offers no incentive for workers to increase output.
problems.s: L08 p.15 표: 시간급 — 관리자 쪽 장점은 안정적 인건비·간편, 단점은 증산 유인 없음. 직원 쪽 단점은 추가 노력이 보상되지 않음.

problems.q: From the employee's point of view, which is a disadvantage of an output-based (incentive) pay system?
opts: Labor costs are stable and pay is easy to compute
There is no incentive to increase output
Pay fluctuates, and workers may be penalized for factors beyond their control such as machine breakdown
Pay is stable with less pressure to produce
problems.a: Pay fluctuates, and workers may be penalized for factors beyond their control such as machine breakdown
why: 인건비 안정이 성과급의 특징이라고 생각함
증산 유인이 없는 것이 성과급의 단점이라고 생각함
안정된 임금이 성과급의 특징이라고 생각함
problems.s: L08 p.15: 성과급의 직원 쪽 단점 — 임금 변동, 기계 고장처럼 통제 밖 요인으로 손해. 나머지 보기는 시간급의 특징입니다.

problems.q: Which compensation system rewards verified skills acquired through training? (two words)
problems.s: L08 p.14, 17: knowledge-based system. 교육 참석과 입증된 역량은 다른 증거입니다.

problems.q: Under straight piecework, the worker is guaranteed a base rate, and a bonus is paid for output above the standard.
problems.fix: That describes base rate + bonus; under straight piecework pay is a direct linear function of output.
problems.s: L08 p.16: Straight piecework — 임금이 산출에 정비례(최저임금법으로 인기 감소). 기본급 보장 + 초과 보너스는 base rate + bonus.

problems.q: In knowledge-based pay, skills to plan, coordinate and guide the work are called ____ skills. (one word)
problems.s: L08 p.17: horizontal = 관련 과업의 폭, vertical = 계획·조정·지도, depth = 전문성.

problems.q: Jobs with high labor content, high frequency, unsafe or tiring conditions, or known quality problems are good candidates for methods analysis.
problems.s: L08 p.20: 연구할 직무 선정 지침.

problems.q: Once the new method is installed (for example, a new instruction screen), methods analysis is complete; follow-up is not part of the procedure.
problems.fix: The last of the seven steps is to follow up the implementation to make sure the improvements were achieved.
problems.s: L08 p.21: 7단계의 마지막은 Follow up implementation to assure improvements have been achieved. 화면을 바꾸는 것은 실행의 일부일 뿐입니다.

problems.q: Which chart compares the busy and idle portions of one cycle for an operator and a machine?
why: SIMO가 작업자와 기계를 비교한다고 생각함
스파게티 도표가 가동·유휴를 보여 준다고 생각함
흐름 공정도가 한 사이클의 가동·유휴를 비교한다고 생각함
problems.s: L08 p.23: worker–machine chart (셀프 계량 예: 고객 7초 작업, 기계 1초 작업). 흐름 공정도는 전체 순서, SIMO는 양손, 스파게티 도표는 걸은 경로.

problems.q: Which chart examines the overall sequence of an operation by focusing on the movements of the operator or the flow of materials? (three words)
problems.s: L08 p.22: flow process chart.

problems.q: Gilbreth's basic motions — search, select, grasp, hold, transport loaded and release — are called what?
problems.s: L08 p.26: therbligs.

problems.q: A SIMO (simultaneous motion) chart plots left- and right-hand activities on one time scale.
problems.s: L08 p.26: SIMO(simultaneous motion) chart는 왼손·오른손 활동을 한 시간축에 그립니다. 걸은 경로는 spaghetti diagram(p.19).

problems.q: A time study gives a mean task time of 6.4 minutes with a standard deviation of 2.1 minutes. For 95% confidence (z = 1.96) and a maximum error of ±10% of the sample mean, how many observations are needed?
Same study (mean 6.4 min, s = 2.1 min, z = 1.96), but the maximum acceptable error is now one-half minute. How many observations are needed?
Ten observed times for one job element total 50 minutes. The analyst's performance rating is 1.2, and the allowance is 10% of job time. Compute the standard time (minutes).

delta: 작업시간 기준 여유 → 근무일 기준 여유

problems.q: Same element (OT = 5 min, PR = 1.2), but the allowance is now 10% of the workday. Compute the standard time (minutes, two decimals).
A performance rating greater than 1 means the worker was slower than normal pace, so normal time is smaller than observed time.
problems.fix: PR greater than 1 means faster than normal, so normal time is larger than observed time.
problems.s: L08 p.32: PR > 1은 정상보다 빠름. NT = OT × PR이므로 NT가 OT보다 큽니다(예: 10% 빠름 → 4 × 1.1 = 4.4분).

problems.q: Recorded times for four cycles are 3, 4, 5 and 4 minutes. The worker was 10% faster than normal pace. Compute the normal time (minutes).
When the allowance is given as a percentage of the workday, the allowance factor is 1 + A.
problems.fix: For a workday-based allowance AF = 1/(1 − A); AF = 1 + A applies when the allowance is based on job time.
problems.s: L08 p.33: workday 기준이면 AF = 1 ÷ (1 − A), job time 기준이면 AF = 1 + A.

problems.q: A standard time refers to a specified job done by a qualified worker under specified conditions, so a different method or workstation can require a different time standard.
problems.s: L08 p.28: Define the method first; qualified worker; same job, different workstation layout → 다른 표준.

problems.q: Which work measurement technique uses published elemental-motion data such as MTM and needs no separate performance rating?
why: 워크 샘플링이 동작별 시간 표를 쓴다고 생각함
스톱워치 연구가 수행도 평가 없이 공표 데이터를 쓴다고 생각함
회사 자체 요소시간 기록을 공표 동작 데이터라고 생각함
problems.s: L08 p.35–36: predetermined time standards(MTM) — 공표된 요소 동작 데이터, 수행도 평가 없음, 생산 전에 분석 가능. 표준요소시간은 회사 자체 연구 기록입니다.

problems.q: Standard elemental times from past studies can be reused for a new job simply because the task has a familiar name.
problems.fix: Reuse requires matching conditions (method, tools, distance, difficulty); a familiar name is not enough.
problems.s: L08 p.35: 방법, 도구, 거리, 난이도 조건이 맞는지 확인해야 합니다. 'A familiar task name does not guarantee an applicable historical time.'

problems.q: Work sampling: z = 1.96 (95% confidence) and e = 0.04. With no prior estimate, use p = 0.50. What sample size n is needed?
Same study (z = 1.96, e = 0.04). After a pilot, the activity was seen in 4 of 20 observations. What sample size n is now needed?
In work sampling with e = 0.05, the allowable error is 5% of the estimated proportion p.
problems.fix: e = 0.05 means ±5 percentage points, not 5% of p.
problems.s: L08 p.39: e = 0.05는 ±5 percentage points이지 p의 5%가 아닙니다.

problems.q: In 40 random observations of a forklift driver, the driver was found travelling empty 6 times. Estimate the proportion of time spent travelling empty (%).
Compare job rotation, job enlargement, job enrichment and mechanization as behavioral approaches to job design.
problems.a: Job rotation has workers exchange roles (e.g. assembly, inspection, packing). Job enlargement adds related tasks at the same responsibility level — more tasks, horizontal. Job enrichment adds planning and coordination responsibility — more authority, vertical. Mechanization uses equipment to reduce repetitive physical effort. Adding more tasks and adding more authority are different changes.

problems.q: Explain how a standard time is obtained from a stopwatch time study, including how many cycles to observe and the formulas for observed, normal and standard time.
problems.a: Define the task and inform the worker. Decide the number of cycles n = (zs ÷ a·x̄)² or (zs ÷ e)², rounded up. Record times: OT = average of recorded times. Rate the performance: NT = OT × PR (PR > 1 means faster than normal). Add allowances for personal delay, unavoidable delay and breaks: ST = NT × AF, with AF = 1 + A when based on job time or 1 ÷ (1 − A) when based on the workday.

problems.q: Compare time-based and output-based compensation systems: give one advantage and one disadvantage of each, for management and for employees.
problems.a: Time-based — management: stable labor costs, easy to administer, but no incentive to raise output; employees: stable pay and less pressure, but extra effort is not rewarded. Output-based — management: lower cost per unit and greater output, but wage computation is harder, output must be measured and quality may suffer; employees: pay is related to effort with a chance to earn more, but pay fluctuates and workers may be penalized for factors beyond their control.

dx.principle: 저비용 전략과 편의 전략은 입지 기준이 다르다

problems.q: A convenience strategy locates near customers to attract market share, as hotels, banks and fast-food chains do.
problems.s: L09 p.7: convenience strategy — 명동처럼 사람이 이미 있는 곳.

problems.q: A low-cost strategy locates near customers in order to attract market share.
problems.fix: Locating near customers to attract market share is a convenience strategy; a low-cost strategy seeks low labor, material or transportation costs.
problems.s: L09 p.7: low-cost strategy는 인건비·원자재비가 낮은 곳, 또는 운송비를 줄이려 시장·원자재 가까이. 고객 가까이에서 점유율을 끄는 것은 convenience strategy.

problems.q: Doing nothing is not one of the options in location planning, because it means no decision is made.
problems.fix: Staying (doing nothing) is one of the four location options, and it is a decision.
problems.s: L09 p.11: 네 가지 선택지 중 하나가 Stay — Do nothing. 'a decision, not the absence of one.'

problems.q: A coffee chain opens a second store two blocks from its own first store, mainly to keep a rival out of the block. Which location option is this?
opts: Add a new location while retaining the existing facility
Shut down one location and move to another
problems.a: Add a new location while retaining the existing facility
why: 가까운 곳에 새 매장을 여는 것을 기존 시설 확장으로 생각함
새 매장을 열면 기존 매장을 닫는 이전이라고 생각함
방어적 출점을 아무것도 안 하는 것으로 생각함
problems.s: L09 p.11–12: 기존 매장을 유지하면서 새 입지 추가 — 시장을 넓히지 않아도 경쟁자 진입을 막는 방어 전략이 될 수 있습니다.

problems.q: A cement plant has worked through the quarry beside it, so its basic input is depleted. Which of the four location options fits? (answer in a short phrase)
accept: shut down one location and move to another
problems.s: L09 p.11–12: 원자재 고갈 → shut down one location and move to another.

problems.q: Firms at the beginning of the supply chain focus on accessibility, consumer demographics and traffic patterns when choosing a location.
problems.fix: Firms at the beginning locate near raw materials; firms at the end focus on accessibility, demographics and traffic.
problems.s: L09 p.9: 앞단(beginning)은 원자재 가까이, 중간은 공급자나 시장 가까이, 끝단(end)이 접근성·인구 특성·교통·관습을 봅니다.

problems.q: Centralized distribution offers scale economies and tight control, while decentralized distribution offers responsiveness to local needs.
problems.s: L09 p.10: Centralized — scale economies, tight control. Decentralized — responsiveness to local needs.

problems.q: Which item is listed as a risk of global location, rather than a disadvantage?
why: 운송비를 위험 항목으로 생각함
수입 제한을 위험 항목으로 생각함
미숙련 노동을 위험 항목으로 생각함
problems.s: L09 p.14: 단점 — 운송비, 보안 비용, 미숙련 노동, 수입 제한, 해외 이전 비판. 위험 — 정치 불안, 테러, 경제 불안, 법 규제, 윤리, 문화 차이.

problems.q: Location alternatives are developed by narrowing in order: country, then region, then community, then site.
problems.s: L09 p.20: ① country ② region ③ community ④ site.

problems.q: Land, transportation access and zoning restrictions are the primary considerations when identifying a region.
problems.fix: Land, transportation and restrictions are the primary considerations at the site level, the last step.
problems.s: L09 p.26: 토지, 교통, 기타 규제(용도지역·허가)는 마지막 site 단계의 고려사항입니다. 지역(region)은 원자재·시장 위치, 노동, 기후·세금을 봅니다(p.22–24).

problems.q: A fruit cannery is located where the fruit is grown because the fresh input spoils quickly. Which raw-material reason is this? (one word)
problems.s: L09 p.22: raw materials 입지 이유 — necessity(채굴·농업), perishability(통조림·냉동), transportation costs(무게·부피가 줄어드는 공정).

problems.q: A bakery and a flower shop locate in their markets because their products are perishable.
problems.s: L09 p.23: 시장 쪽 입지 — 부패하는 완제품은 시장에 둡니다. 통조림 공장은 반대로 부패하는 '투입물' 쪽에 둡니다.

problems.q: A carmaker runs an engine plant in one city and a body stamping plant in another. Which multiple-plant strategy is this?
why: 공장이 나뉘어도 범용 공장이라고 생각함
엔진·차체 분할을 제품별 분할로 생각함
도시가 다르면 시장 지역별 공장이라고 생각함
problems.s: L09 p.29–30: 한 제품의 공정 단계(엔진, 차체)를 나눈 것 → process plant strategy. 부품이 많은 제품에 맞고, 조정이 핵심 과제입니다.

delta: 공정 단계 분할 → 제품 종류 분할

problems.q: An appliance maker makes all refrigerators in one plant and all washers in another, each plant supplying the entire market. Which multiple-plant strategy is this? (two words)
problems.s: L09 p.28, 30: 제품 종류별로 공장을 나눔 → product plant strategy.

problems.q: A market area plant strategy is desirable when shipping costs are high, and it requires centralized coordination of decisions to add, delete, expand or downsize plants.
problems.s: L09 p.28: market area plant — 지역별 시장 담당, 운송비가 클 때, 빠른 납품, 중앙 조정 필요.

problems.q: A general-purpose plant strategy dedicates each plant to one product type to gain economies of scale.
problems.fix: General-purpose plants are flexible and handle a range of products, responding quickly to changes.
problems.s: L09 p.29: general-purpose plant는 유연해서 여러 제품을 처리하고 제품·시장 변화에 빨리 대응합니다.

problems.q: For service and retail businesses, nearness to raw materials is usually the prime location consideration.
problems.fix: Nearness to raw materials is not usually a consideration; services look at demographics, competition, traffic and convenience.
problems.s: L09 p.31: 서비스·소매는 원자재 근접을 거의 보지 않고 인구 특성, 경쟁, 교통량, 편의를 봅니다. 제조업은 비용(노동·에너지·자재·운송)을 봅니다.

problems.q: Similar types of businesses — electronics shops, car dealerships, restaurants — locating near one another is called what?
problems.s: L09 p.32: clustering. 옆 경쟁자가 고객이 오는 이유가 되기도 합니다(용산 전자상가).

problems.q: Customer access is a prime consideration for every service business, including service call centers and web-based retailers.
problems.fix: Customer access is prime for restaurants, hotels, banks and supermarkets, but not important for call centers or web-based retailers.
problems.s:
L09 p.31: 고객 접근성은 식당·호텔·은행·슈퍼마켓에서는 최우선이지만 콜센터·온라인 소매에서는 중요하지 않습니다.

함정: 'every'.

dx.principle: 총비용 선의 교차점에서 최저 비용 입지가 바뀐다

problems.q: Location X has a fixed cost of $120,000 per year and a variable cost of $15 per unit. Location Y has a fixed cost of $200,000 and a variable cost of $10 per unit. At what annual output do their total costs become equal?
Same two locations (X: FC $120,000, v $15; Y: FC $200,000, v $10). The expected output is 20,000 units per year. Which location has the lower total cost?
opts: They cost the same at any output
It cannot be decided without the revenue per unit
X, because its fixed cost is lower
why: 교차점이 있어도 비용이 늘 같다고 생각함
비용 비교에 단가 정보가 꼭 필요하다고 생각함
고정비가 낮은 입지가 생산량과 관계없이 싸다고 생각함

problems.q: If location B has both a lower fixed cost and a lower variable cost than location D, then D is never the cheapest location at any output level.
problems.s: L09 p.39: B가 고정비·변동비 모두 낮으면 모든 생산량에서 B가 D보다 쌉니다 → D는 never.

problems.q: In locational cost-volume analysis, the cheapest location is the same for every output level.
problems.fix: Because total-cost lines cross, the cheapest location changes with the output level.
problems.s: L09 p.38–39: 총비용 선이 교차하므로 0–4,999는 B, 5,001–11,111은 C, 11,112 이상은 A처럼 생산량에 따라 바뀝니다.

dx.principle: Σ(가중치 × 점수), 최저 허용 점수 확인

problems.q: Factor rating for one site: labor cost (weight 0.40) scores 80, market access (weight 0.35) scores 70, taxes (weight 0.25) scores 90. Compute the composite score.

Two sites are factor-rated with a minimum acceptable score of 60 on every factor. Site 1 has the higher composite score (82) but scores 50 on safety. Site 2 has a composite score of 78 and meets every minimum. Which site should be chosen?
opts: Site 1, because its composite score is higher
Neither, because the composite scores are too close
why: 합산 점수가 높으면 최저 기준 미달이어도 고른다고 생각함
합산 점수 차이가 작으면 둘 다 탈락이라고 생각함
최저 허용 점수를 합산 점수에 적용한다고 생각함
problems.s: L09 p.40 step 6: 합산 점수가 가장 높은 대안을 고르되, 최저 허용 점수를 못 넘으면 제외합니다 → Site 2.

problems.q: In factor rating the weights typically sum to 1.00, and the result depends heavily on the weights, which are opinions.
problems.s: L09 p.40, 43, 63: 가중치가 결과를 정합니다. Alt 1이 근접성에서 40점 앞서도 가중치 .10 때문에 집니다.

problems.q: Four destinations receive identical quantities. Their coordinates are (1, 3), (4, 7), (7, 2) and (8, 4). Find the x coordinate of the center of gravity.
Same four destinations (1, 3), (4, 7), (7, 2), (8, 4), but they now receive 100, 200, 300 and 400 units per week respectively. Find the x coordinate of the center of gravity.
The center of gravity must be located at one of the destinations.
problems.fix: The center of gravity is a computed place and need not coincide with any destination.
problems.s: L09 p.47: 결과 (4.5, 4)에는 목적지가 없습니다. 'The answer is a place, not one of the customers.'

problems.q: The center of gravity method guarantees the minimum road transport cost for a distribution center.
problems.fix: It gives a starting search area; it does not guarantee the minimum road transport cost.
problems.s: L09 p.63: 무게중심법은 배송 센터의 탐색 출발 지역을 줄 뿐, 최소 도로 운송비를 보장하지 않습니다.

problems.q: The P-median model locates a given number P of facilities and assigns each demand node to one facility so as to minimize the total demand-weighted distance.
problems.s: L09 p.56: P-median — P는 주어지고, 위치와 배정을 정해 수요 가중 거리 합을 최소화. single allocation.

problems.q: P-median with P = 2. Demands: A = 15, B = 5, C = 11, D = 16. Facilities are opened at A and C. B is served from A (distance 24) and D is served from C (distance 15). Compute the total demand-weighted distance.
In the P-median model, what does the constraint Y<sub>ij</sub> ≤ X<sub>j</sub> mean?
opts: Each customer is assigned exactly once
A customer can be assigned only to a facility that is open
problems.a: A customer can be assigned only to a facility that is open
why: Yij ≤ Xj가 이진 변수 조건이라고 생각함
Yij ≤ Xj가 단일 배정 제약이라고 생각함
Yij ≤ Xj가 시설 수 P 제약이라고 생각함
problems.s: L09 p.59: Yij ≤ Xj — Assignment is allowed only for an open facility. ΣX = P는 시설 수, 각 고객 한 번 배정은 single allocation.

problems.q: Describe the four multiple-plant manufacturing strategies, giving the main reason to use each.
problems.a: Product plant: each plant is dedicated to certain products and usually supplies the entire market — specialization, economies of scale. Market area plant: each plant serves a geographic segment — desirable when shipping costs are high; rapid delivery, but needs centralized coordination. Process plant: different plants focus on different steps of a process (engine plant, body stamping) — for products with many components; specialization, but extra shipping and coordination. General-purpose plant: flexible plants handle a range of products — quick response to product or market changes.
pts: Product plant: 제품별 전담, 전체 시장, 규모의 경제
Market area: 지역 담당, 운송비 클 때
Process plant: 공정 단계 분할, 부품 많은 제품, 조정

problems.q: Compare the four techniques for evaluating location alternatives: what question each answers and what it cannot do.
problems.a: Locational cost-volume-profit analysis finds which single location is cheapest at a given output, but ignores qualitative factors. Factor rating scores locations with weighted factors so judgment can be included, but the weights are opinions and the result follows them. Center of gravity gives a starting search area for one distribution center, but does not guarantee minimum road transport cost. A location optimization model (e.g. P-median) chooses which P locations to open and who each serves, but needs every demand and distance as data.
pts: CVP: 생산량별 최저 비용 / 정성 요인 무시
Factor rating: 가중 점수 / 가중치가 의견
Center of gravity: 출발 지역 / 최소 비용 보장 못 함
Optimization: P개 위치+배정 / 모든 자료 필요

problems.q: Explain the general procedure for location decisions and the four geographic levels at which alternatives are developed, with one key factor for each level.
problems.a: Decide the criteria, identify important factors (e.g. location of markets or raw materials), develop alternatives and evaluate them. Alternatives narrow from country (government policy, market potential, labor, financial incentives) to region (location of raw materials and markets, labor, climate and taxes) to community (quality of life, local attitudes, taxes, development support) to site (land, transportation, zoning and other restrictions).

problems.q: Aggregate planning is intermediate-range capacity planning that typically covers a time horizon of 2 to 18 months.
problems.s: L10 p.7: 2~18개월 중기 계획, 목표는 자원을 효과적으로 써서 수요를 맞추는 생산 계획.

problems.q: Aggregate planning should be done separately for each individual product model, because aggregation would hide important detail.
problems.fix: Aggregate planning uses a group of similar products, because individual-item demand cannot be predicted accurately.
problems.s: L10 p.9–10: 비슷한 제품군(예: 4K TV 46·55·65인치) 단위로 계획합니다. 개별 품목의 수요 시기·양은 정확히 예측할 수 없어 총괄해야 유연성을 얻습니다. 'A forecast for one model misses; a forecast for the family holds.'

problems.q: Which decision belongs to intermediate-range plans?
why: 작업 순서가 중기 계획이라고 생각함
제품 설계가 중기 계획이라고 생각함
입지가 중기 계획이라고 생각함
problems.s: L10 p.6: 장기 — 용량, 입지, 배치, 제품 설계, 작업 시스템. 중기 — 고용 수준, 산출, 완제품 재고, 하청, 백오더. 단기 — 로트, 주문량, 기계 부하, 작업 배정·순서.

problems.q: Machine loading and job sequencing are long-range planning decisions.
problems.fix: Machine loading and job sequencing are short-range decisions.
problems.s: L10 p.6: 기계 부하와 작업 순서는 단기(short-range) 계획입니다.

problems.q: In the planning sequence (business plan → ? → master schedule), which plan establishes operations capacity? (two words)
problems.s: L10 p.8: business plan → aggregate plan(운영 용량) → master schedule(특정 제품 일정).

problems.q: A demand strategy is proactive: it controls demand to match capacity.
problems.s: L10 p.15: demand strategy — proactive, 수요를 용량에 맞춤. capacity strategy — reactive, 용량을 수요에 맞춤.

problems.q: Back orders take orders in one period and promise delivery in a later period, so they work only if customers are willing to wait.
problems.s: L10 p.16: back orders — 이번 기간에 주문을 받고 납품은 다음 기간으로 약속. 고객이 기다릴 의사에 달려 있습니다. (평준화 계획에서도 수단으로 쓰입니다, p.20.)

problems.q: An air-conditioner plant also makes heaters on the same line for the winter. Which aggregate planning strategy is this?
opts: Capacity strategy: hire and lay off workers
why: 같은 라인에서 다른 제품을 만드는 것을 하청으로 생각함
제품을 바꾸는 것을 고용 조정으로 생각함
비수기 제품을 만드는 것을 가격 조정으로 생각함
problems.s: L10 p.16, 18: 한 공장이 에어컨과 히터를 함께 → creating new demand(수요 전략).

problems.q: Overtime, part-time workers, inventories, subcontracting and hiring/laying off workers all belong to which kind of aggregate planning strategy? (one word)
problems.s: L10 p.17: supply(capacity) strategy.

dx.principle: 추종은 산출 = 수요, 평준화는 산출 일정

problems.q: A chase demand strategy sets the planned output for each period at the expected demand for that period.
problems.s: L10 p.20: chase — 기간마다 용량을 예상 수요에 맞춤.

problems.q: The chase demand approach works best when inventory carrying costs are low and the costs of changing capacity are high.
problems.fix: Chase works best when inventory carrying costs are high and the costs of changing capacity are low.
problems.s: L10 p.25: chase는 재고 유지비가 높고 용량 변경비가 낮을 때 가장 잘 맞습니다. level은 재고비·백오더비가 비교적 낮을 때(p.26).

problems.q: Which is an advantage of the level capacity approach?
opts: Output matches demand period by period
why: 노동 활용도가 높은 것이 평준화의 장점이라고 생각함
평준화도 기간마다 수요를 맞춘다고 생각함
재고 투자가 적은 것이 평준화의 장점이라고 생각함
problems.s: L10 p.25–26: level의 장점은 안정적 산출과 인력, 단점은 재고비 증가. 재고 투자 적음·노동 활용 높음은 chase의 장점.

problems.q: A hospital emergency room can follow a level capacity approach by building up an inventory of its service during slow periods.
problems.fix: An ER service cannot be inventoried, so it chases demand with part-time cover and overtime.
problems.s: L10 p.18, 27: 응급실 서비스는 재고로 쌓을 수 없어 파트타임·초과근무로 수요를 추종(chase)합니다.

dx.principle: 평균 재고 = (기초 + 기말) ÷ 2, 비용 = 단가 × 수량

problems.q: A level plan produces 175 units per period. Forecasts for periods 1–4 are 100, 150, 200 and 250 units; starting inventory is zero. Inventory costs $1 per unit per period on average inventory. Compute the total inventory cost ($).

delta: 수요 순서 반대 → 재고 대신 백로그

problems.q: Same level plan of 175 units per period and zero starting inventory, but the forecasts for periods 1–4 are now 250, 200, 150 and 100. Back orders cost $5 per unit per period. Compute the total backlog cost ($).
problems.s: L10 p.31–33: 부족분은 다음 기간으로 넘어갑니다. 백로그 = P1 75, P2 75+25 = 100, P3 100−25 = 75, P4 0 → 합 250 × $5 = $1,250. 백로그는 그 기간 전체에 있는 것으로 봅니다.

problems.q: In one period a plan uses 250 units of regular output at $3 per unit, 30 units of overtime at $4 per unit, and carries an average inventory of 60 units at $1.50 per unit. There is no backlog. Compute the total cost for the period ($).
Average inventory for a period is (beginning inventory + ending inventory) ÷ 2, and the inventory cost of the period is based on this average.
Trial-and-error techniques guarantee the optimal aggregate plan as long as each alternative's total cost is computed correctly.
problems.fix: Trial and error compares only the plans tried and does not guarantee an optimal plan.
problems.s: L10 p.30, 41: 시행착오는 최적을 보장하지 않습니다. 아무도 시도하지 않은 더 나은 계획이 있을 수 있습니다. 최적해는 LP.

problems.q: Which approach represents the objective and the constraints with linear equations and obtains the optimal aggregate plan?
why: 갱신 주기가 최적화 기법이라고 생각함
시행착오표가 최적해를 구한다고 생각함
시뮬레이션이 최적해를 증명한다고 생각함
problems.s: L10 p.42: LP — 선형식, 최적해. Simulation — 시나리오 테스트로 수용 가능한 해.

problems.q: Yield management maximizes revenue with variable pricing: discounts during low demand and higher prices during peak demand.
problems.s: L10 p.46: 항공·식당·호텔이 사용.

problems.q: Yield management works well for a TV plant selling 65-inch sets, because the plant's capacity is fixed.
problems.fix: It fails for the TV plant because its output is not perishable; an unsold set waits in inventory.
problems.s: L10 p.47: 수익관리는 고정 용량 + 소멸하는 산출 + 지불 의사가 다른 고객이 함께 있어야 합니다. 팔리지 않은 TV는 재고로 기다리므로 산출이 소멸하지 않습니다.

problems.q: What is the result of disaggregating an aggregate plan, showing the quantity and timing of specific end items for a horizon often 6 to 8 weeks ahead? (abbreviation or full name)
problems.s: L10 p.49: MPS(master production schedule), 줄여서 master schedule.

problems.q: An aggregate plan calls for 250 4K TVs in period 2. The master schedule assigns 60 units to the 55-inch model and 110 units to the 65-inch model. How many units must go to the 75-inch model?
problems.s: L10 p.50: MPS 행들의 합은 기간마다 총괄계획과 같아야 합니다 → 250 − 60 − 110 = 80.

problems.q: Rough cut capacity planning (RCCP) tests the feasibility of a tentative master schedule by approximately balancing capacity and demand.
problems.s: L10 p.56: RCCP — 생산·창고 시설, 인력, 공급자 용량을 점검해 MPS를 실행 불가능하게 할 큰 결함이 없는지 확인.

problems.q: In which time-fence phase of a master schedule can new orders or cancellations be entered easily, with order-promise dates only tentative?
why: 확정(firm) 구간에서 약속이 잠정이라고 생각함
동결 구간에서 주문 변경이 쉽다고 생각함
반유동 구간에서 맞바꿈 없이 주문이 들어간다고 생각함
problems.s: L10 p.57: frozen(1–3주) 변경 불가·비쌈, slushy(4–5주) 맞바꿈 필요, liquid(6–9주) 주문·취소 쉬움·약속 잠정. firm은 frozen의 다른 이름.

problems.q: In the frozen portion of the master schedule, order changes are easy and order-promise dates are tentative.
problems.fix: In the frozen portion, changes may be impossible or costly and promise dates are highly reliable; easy changes belong to the liquid portion.
problems.s: L10 p.57, 63: frozen은 변경이 불가능하거나 비싸고 약속 날짜의 신뢰도가 높습니다. 쉬운 변경·잠정 약속은 liquid.

dx.principle: 예상 재고 = 이전 − max(예측, 주문) + MPS

problems.q: Beginning inventory is 50. Period 1 has a forecast of 30 and committed customer orders of 36. No MPS quantity arrives in period 1. Compute the projected on-hand inventory at the end of period 1.
problems.s: L10 p.58–59: projected on hand = 50 − max(30, 36) = 14.

problems.q: Continuing: period 2 has a forecast of 30 and orders of 20. Because projected on-hand would fall below zero, an MPS lot of 70 is scheduled in period 2. Compute the projected on-hand inventory at the end of period 2.

dx.principle: ATP는 다음 MPS 전까지의 주문을 뺀다, 누적하지 않음

problems.q: On-hand inventory is 40. MPS quantities of 60 are scheduled in periods 3 and 5 (none in period 1). Committed orders are 25 (period 1), 10 (period 2), 15 (period 3) and 20 (period 4). Compute ATP for period 1.
problems.s: L10 p.61–62: ATP(1) = on hand + MPS − (다음 MPS 전까지의 주문) = 40 + 0 − (25 + 10) = 5.

problems.q: Same data (MPS 60 in periods 3 and 5; orders 15 in period 3 and 20 in period 4). Compute ATP for period 3.
problems.s: L10 p.61–62: 이후 MPS가 있는 기간은 ATP = MPS − (다음 MPS 전까지의 주문) = 60 − (15 + 20) = 25. 앞 기간의 ATP를 더하지 않습니다.

problems.q: A customer asks for 60 more units in week 3. ATP for week 3 is 56, while the master schedule produces 70 that week. The planner can promise all 60 because 70 units are being produced.
problems.fix: Only the ATP of 56 can be promised; part of the 70 is already committed to customer orders.
problems.s: L10 p.63: 약속 가능한 양은 ATP 행에서 읽습니다 → 60이 아니라 56까지. 70 중 14는 이미 확정 주문에 묶여 있습니다.

problems.q: When computing projected on-hand inventory, the current requirement for a period is the larger of the forecast and the committed customer orders.
problems.s: L10 p.58: current requirements = max(forecast, committed orders).

problems.q: Compare the chase demand and level capacity approaches to aggregate planning: how each works, one advantage and one disadvantage of each, and the cost conditions under which each works best.
problems.a: Chase demand sets output each period equal to expected demand, adjusting capacity (hiring, lay-offs, overtime). Advantages: low inventory investment, high labor utilization. Disadvantages: cost of adjusting output and workforce, overtime and idle time, varying utilization. Works best when inventory carrying costs are high and the costs of changing capacity are low. Level capacity keeps a steady regular-time output and workforce, letting inventory, overtime, subcontracting or back orders absorb variations. Advantage: stable output and workforce. Disadvantage: greater inventory cost. Works best when inventory carrying and backlog costs are relatively low.
pts: 비용 조건: chase는 재고비↑·변경비↓, level은 재고·백로그비↓

problems.q: Explain how projected on-hand inventory and available-to-promise (ATP) inventory are calculated in master scheduling, and why a sales representative should read the ATP row rather than the inventory row.
problems.a: Projected on hand = previous inventory − current requirements, where current requirements = max(forecast, committed orders); an MPS lot is scheduled when it would fall below zero. ATP is the uncommitted inventory: for the first period, ATP = on hand + MPS − orders up to the next MPS; for each later period with an MPS, ATP = MPS − orders up to the next MPS, without cumulating. Projected on-hand includes stock already committed to customers, so only the ATP row shows what can still be promised.
pts: 이후 ATP 식, 누적 안 함

problems.q: List the demand strategies and the capacity (supply) strategies available to an aggregate planner, and explain the basic difference between the two groups.
problems.a: Demand strategies are proactive — they control demand to match capacity: pricing (shift demand to off-peak; more effective with higher price elasticity), promotion, back orders (take orders now, deliver later), and creating new demand (e.g. heaters on an air-conditioner line). Capacity strategies are reactive — they control capacity to match demand: hiring and laying off, overtime and slack time, part-time workers, inventories, and subcontracting. Most practical plans are mixed.

problems.q: Korean manufacturers compete against lower-cost producers below them and more advanced producers above them. The advantage that is left is one that is managed, not priced. It is:
opts: Lower labour cost than the producers below them
Operational efficiency: flexible production, consistent quality, delivery speed
Higher productivity in services than in manufacturing
problems.a: Operational efficiency: flexible production, consistent quality, delivery speed
why: 낮은 인건비가 아직 강점이라고 생각함
일할 나이의 인구가 늘고 있다고 생각함
서비스 생산성이 제조업보다 높다고 생각함
problems.s: L01 p.8 '남은 강점: 운영 효율'(빠른 납기, 유연한 생산, 일정한 품질). 인건비는 10년간 약 25% 올랐고(p.7), 일할 나이 인구는 줄고 있으며, 서비스 생산성(OECD 27위)은 제조업(6위)보다 낮습니다(p.6).

problems.q: The comparison of feedback against previously established standards to determine if corrective action is needed is called:
why: 중간 측정값인 피드백이 곧 통제라고 생각함
부가가치가 기준 비교 단계라고 생각함
변환 과정 자체가 통제라고 생각함
problems.s: L02 p.6: control = 결과를 기준과 비교해 조치가 필요한지 정하는 것. Feedback은 중간 측정값, value-added는 변환이 더한 가치, conversion process는 변환 과정 자체.

problems.q: In the Good vs. Service table, which one describes services but not goods?
why: 서비스의 결과물도 눈에 보인다고 생각함
서비스의 생산성 측정이 쉽다고 생각함
서비스도 재고가 많다고 생각함
problems.s: L02 p.9 표: 서비스는 고객 접촉이 많습니다. 나머지(유형, 측정 쉬움, 재고 많음)는 재화의 특징.

problems.q: In a supply chain, which flow moves from the final customers back toward the suppliers?
why: 재화·서비스가 고객에서 공급자로 흐른다고 생각함
재고 수준이 하나의 흐름이라고 생각함
공급망의 단계(주체)를 흐름으로 생각함
problems.s: L02 p.11: 주문·정보·대금은 고객에서 공급자 쪽으로 거꾸로 흐릅니다. 재화·서비스는 앞으로, 재고 수준은 두 흐름이 맞지 않을 때의 결과.

problems.q: Variation that has identifiable sources, and that can be reduced or eliminated by analysis and corrective action, is:
opts: Variety of goods or services being offered
why: 무작위 변동도 원인을 찾아 없앨 수 있다고 생각함
구조적 수요 변동이 없애야 할 대상이라고 생각함
제품 다양성이 원인을 찾아 없애는 변동이라고 생각함
problems.s: L02 p.22: assignable variation은 원인을 찾을 수 있어 고치면 줄이거나 없앨 수 있습니다. random은 자연 변동, structural은 예측 가능한 수요 변동(용량 계획에 씀), variety는 종류 증가.

problems.q: Characteristics of an organization’s goods or services that cause it to be perceived as better than the competition are called:
why: 주문 자격 요건이 경쟁사보다 나은 특징이라고 생각함
환경 탐색을 제품의 특징으로 생각함
전술을 제품의 특징으로 생각함
problems.s: L03 p.23: order winner = 경쟁사보다 낫다고 느끼게 하는 특징. order qualifier는 시장에 들어오기 위한 최소 기준.

problems.q: Which one is “the methods and actions taken to accomplish strategies” — the “how to” part of the process?
why: 실행(doing)인 운영이 '어떻게'라고 생각함
목표가 실행 방법이라고 생각함
미션이 실행 방법이라고 생각함
problems.s: L03 p.17: tactics = 방법과 행동, 즉 '어떻게'. operations는 실제 실행, goals는 목표(p.13), mission은 존재 이유(p.12).

problems.q: In SWOT analysis, which one is an external factor (for Opportunities and Threats)?
why: 인적 자원을 외부 요인으로 생각함
재무 자원을 외부 요인으로 생각함
시설·장비를 외부 요인으로 생각함
problems.s: L03 p.21: 외부 요인은 경제, 정치, 법·규제, 기술, 경쟁, 시장. 인적·재무 자원, 시설·장비는 내부(강점/약점).

problems.q: Which one is NOT a feature common to all forecasts?
opts: Techniques assume some underlying causal system that existed in the past will persist into the future
Forecasts for groups of items are more accurate than those for individual items
Forecast accuracy increases as the forecasting horizon increases
Because random variation is always present, there will always be some residual error
problems.a: Forecast accuracy increases as the forecasting horizon increases
why: 과거 인과 체계 지속 가정이 공통 특징이 아니라고 생각함
그룹 예측이 더 정확하다는 것이 공통 특징이 아니라고 생각함
잔여 오차가 항상 남는다는 것이 공통 특징이 아니라고 생각함
problems.s: L04 p.10: 예측은 멀리 내다볼수록 정확도가 떨어집니다. 보기는 이것을 거꾸로 말해서 NOT 문항의 정답입니다(태풍 경로 원, p.12).

problems.q: Which method is an iterative process intended to achieve a consensus (agreement): circulate a questionnaire, keep responses anonymous, and build the next questionnaire from the responses?
why: 경영진 의견법이 익명 반복 설문이라고 생각함
소비자 조사가 합의를 위한 반복 설문이라고 생각함
영업사원 의견이 익명 반복 설문이라고 생각함
problems.s: L04 p.26: Delphi는 '질문지 → 익명 응답 → 다음 질문지'를 합의될 때까지 반복합니다. 경영진 의견법은 익명 반복이 없습니다.

problems.q: Wavelike variations lasting more than one year are called:
why: 추세가 물결 모양 변동이라고 생각함
계절성이 1년 넘는 파동이라고 생각함
불규칙 변동이 반복되는 파동이라고 생각함
problems.s: L04 p.30: cycle은 물결 모양이고 1년보다 오래 갑니다. trend는 장기 방향, seasonality는 1년 안의 달력 변동, irregular은 특별한 일로 생기며 반복되지 않음.

problems.q: Which statement about the forecast accuracy metrics MAD and MSE is correct?
opts: MAD weights all errors evenly; MSE weights errors according to their squared values
MAD weights errors according to their squared values; MSE weights all errors evenly
MAD weights errors according to relative error; MSE weights all errors evenly
MAD and MSE both weight errors according to relative error
problems.a: MAD weights all errors evenly; MSE weights errors according to their squared values
why: MAD와 MSE의 가중 방식을 서로 바꿔 생각함
MAD가 상대오차로 가중한다고 생각함
MAD·MSE가 모두 상대오차를 쓴다고 생각함
problems.s: L04 p.16: MAD는 모든 오차에 같은 가중치, MSE는 제곱으로 가중. 상대오차로 가중하는 것은 MAPE.

problems.q: In linear regression, r² (the square of the correlation coefficient) is 0.79. This means:
opts: 79% of the points are exactly on the line
The forecast is right 79% of the time
About 79% of the variability in y is “explained” by the independent variable x
y goes up by 0.79 when x goes up by 1
problems.a: About 79% of the variability in y is “explained” by the independent variable x
why: r²가 선 위에 있는 점의 비율이라고 생각함
r²가 예측이 맞는 횟수의 비율이라고 생각함
r²를 기울기 b의 뜻으로 생각함
problems.s: L04 p.62: r²는 y의 변동 중 x로 '설명되는' 비율입니다(기온 예: r = 0.89, r² = 0.79). x가 1 늘 때 y의 변화는 기울기 b.

problems.q: In idea generation, reverse engineering — disassembling and inspecting a competitor’s product to discover product improvements — belongs to which source of ideas?
why: 역설계가 공급망 기반 아이디어라고 생각함
역설계가 연구 기반 아이디어라고 생각함
가치 분석이 아이디어의 출처라고 생각함
problems.s: L05 p.13: reverse engineering은 competitor based 아이디어. value analysis는 비용을 줄이는 방법(p.23)이지 출처가 아닙니다.

problems.q: Remanufacturing — refurbishing used products by replacing worn-out or defective components — fits which of the 3-Rs?
why: 재제조가 비용·자재 줄이기라고 생각함
부품 교체를 재활용이라고 생각함
Re-design이 3R에 들어 있다고 생각함
problems.s: L05 p.22/24: Re-use = 반품된 제품의 부품을 다시 씀, remanufacturing이 그 예. Reduce는 비용·재료 줄이기, Recycle은 재료를 되찾아 다시 씀. Re-design은 3R이 아닙니다.

problems.q: In the Kano model, which kind of customer requirement adds only a little to customer satisfaction when it is met, but causes dissatisfaction when it is missing?
why: 감동 품질이 없으면 불만이 생긴다고 생각함
성능 품질이 있어도 만족이 거의 안 는다고 생각함
robust quality가 카노 분류라고 생각함
problems.s: L05 p.39: basic quality는 있어도 만족이 조금만 늘지만 없으면 불만이 큽니다. excitement는 없어도 불만 없음, performance는 비례. robust는 카노 분류가 아님(robust design p.33).

problems.q: In service design, which case has the greatest opportunity for standardization?
why: 접촉·다양성이 모두 많을 때 표준화가 쉽다고 생각함
접촉이 많아도 다양성만 적으면 가장 표준화하기 쉽다고 생각함
접촉만 적으면 가장 표준화하기 쉽다고 생각함
problems.s: L05 p.47: 고객 접촉이 적고 요구의 다양성도 적을 때 가장 표준화하기 쉽습니다. 둘 다 많으면 가장 맞춤형, 하나만 많으면 일부 표준화.

problems.q: Which one is correct about the capacity cushion?
opts: Extra capacity used to offset demand uncertainty
More demand uncertainty, need less capacity cushion
It is design capacity minus effective capacity
It is the step that has less capacity than the other steps
problems.a: Extra capacity used to offset demand uncertainty
why: 수요가 불확실할수록 여유분을 줄여야 한다고 생각함
여유분이 설계 용량 − 유효 용량이라고 생각함
여유분이 병목 공정이라고 생각함
problems.s: L06 p.20: cushion = 100% − 가동률, 불확실한 수요에 대비한 여유 용량. 불확실할수록 더 필요. 설계 − 유효는 휴식·정비 몫(p.11), 용량이 낮은 단계는 병목(p.34).

problems.q: Which capacity strategy builds capacity when demand exceeds current capacity?
why: 선도 전략이 수요가 용량을 넘은 뒤 늘린다고 생각함
추적 전략이 큰 단위로 한 번에 늘린다고 생각함
여유분을 용량 전략의 이름으로 생각함
problems.s: L06 p.40: following = 수요가 현재 용량을 넘은 뒤에 늘림. leading은 미리, tracking은 조금씩 자주. cushion은 전략 이름이 아니라 여유 용량 개념(p.20).

problems.q: In service capacity planning, which one is a demand management strategy?
why: 임시 인력이 수요 관리 전략이라고 생각함
외주가 수요 관리 전략이라고 생각함
2교대가 수요를 옮기는 전략이라고 생각함
problems.s: L06 p.26: demand management = 가격, 홍보, 할인으로 수요를 바쁜 때에서 한가한 때로 옮김. 임시 직원·외주는 공급 쪽, 2교대는 용량 증가(p.13).
